scope: Theorem 4.1 (Joint analytic parametrization) of the manuscript “Continuous Phase Foliations Create Analytic Caustic Collars” (preprints/Continuous-Phase-Foliations-Create-Analytic-Caustic-Collars-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 357beeb0c0854e26), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are positive numbers s, d, with d < s, and a function V (y, t), holomorphic on {|ℑy| < 2s, |t| < d}, such that V − y is 2π-periodic in y, V is even in t, and V (ȳ, t̄) = V (y, t), V (y, 0) = y. Moreover Vy is uniformly close to one, and D1 V (y, t), V (y + t, t)  + D2 V (y − t, t), V (y, t)  = 0 (4.1) for |ℑy| < s, |t| < d. In particular Vy > 0 on the real domain.
